verdict.rationale: Poly's docs describe file sync (desktop folder sync, Finder tag sync, sharing, MCP/CLI integrations) but nowhere claim end-to-end encryption that the vendor itself cannot read; in fact the architecture explicitly routes files through Poly's servers for indexing/search, and community comments explicitly worry that Poly's remote servers read and analyze all files, contradicting the premise of vendor-blind E2EE. No evidence of an E2EE sync mechanism exists in the pack.
